subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw be allowed to mutate the public Telegram bot profile photo from Web UI assistant-avatar changes, and if so should that be an explicit user action or an opt-in automatic sync?
rationale: This crosses from local OpenClaw identity rendering into external account/profile mutation with a bot token and uploaded media, so implementation needs maintainer intent before a repair PR is safe.

options.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned sync control or setting that uses `setMyProfilePhoto`, shows status/errors, and requires live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep BotFather/manual profile ownership
options.body: Document that Web UI avatars are local OpenClaw identity only and Telegram bot profile photos remain managed in Telegram/BotFather.

options.title: Automatic bidirectional sync
options.body: Automatically propagate avatar changes both ways, accepting higher surprise, privacy, and conflict-resolution risk.

recommendation.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned sync control or setting that uses `setMyProfilePhoto`, shows status/errors, and requires live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame routes the carried-forward avatar and Telegram command surfaces to this contributor, and the decision is cross-cutting product/security policy.
